content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: A sweeping tax reform plan unveiled by the administration has sparked widespread protests across major cities, with demonstrators calling for more progressive taxation and wealth redistribution.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: The plan includes a significant increase in corporate taxes and a new wealth tax on individuals with assets over $50 million.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Protest organizer Alex Lee stated, 'This is about fairness and ensuring that those who benefit most from our economy pay their fair share.'

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Economist Dr. Rachel Patel explained, 'The current system is regressive and needs to be reformed to promote greater equality.'
